body: Chief on the strands checkpoint (m1 confirms on return): APPROVED with the two open choices decided — (a) 1-per-unit, not token-span mass: these rates answer 'how many remembered units of kind X', and span mass would re-import the quantity leak through a different door; a later real observedMass may replace the 1 only when it is an observation, never a placeholder sum; (b) fragmentation is a SITUATION graph (situations + relational edges; MentalStateFact with empty situations adds no node) — an atom graph with exclusions would keep atomization in the denominator. Two grains as you list them (UNIT: density/purity/probeGain/semanticization/otherEventDrift/redundancy; SITUATION: anchoring/perceptual/mental/relationalIntegration/fragmentation), Coverage.of on every rate with eligible = participant units (or target-addressed units for target-only strands). targetMass stays the raw atom-mass sum but its Scaladoc must say 'atom mass (traditional sheet); not a measure of remembering' and no rate may derive from it. Laws 1–6 as written plus order invariance. Sequencing: after the phenomenology ack; bead 9 (ProfileStrand) wraps your outputs afterward — coordinate strand names with cursor-grok-4.6-help on its thread.
